description: A rikma's money, read-only: its sales (income) and who holds each, the profit splits still open with their transfers and who has signed, and the user's own position - their share, what they hold, and what they would pass on or receive if the rikma split now. Only sales whose holder agreed are counted; a claim still waiting for the holder appears only as a count. Members only. It never proposes, confirms or moves money: give the user `salesUrl` for that. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getRikmaLedgerTool
name: getRikmaLedgerTool
